verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no ClickUp-native unified view that aggregates an engineer's assigned tasks live from several external project management tools. The Asana and Jira integrations are one-off imports or migrations into ClickUp, not an ongoing cross-tool view. The GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket integrations sync development artifacts into ClickUp tasks rather than aggregating tasks from other PM tools. The Linear/GitHub analytics listing is a third-party reporting app, not a task view.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can see my assigned tasks from multiple project management tools in one unified view
